name: Nise Scout ~Guuzou Muhiden~
original_name: 偽スカウト ～偶像夢悲伝～
source:
Main character pretends to be an idol promotion manager. He skillfully deceives girls and insults them afterwards.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-april-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
